title.narrative: Scaling up UNESCO-PJMF Collaboration on Promoting Ethical Governance of AI for Greater Impact

description.narrative:
This project aims to enhance global AI governance by addressing critical ethical challenges, including transparency, accountability, equity, and inclusivity. Building on UNESCO’s Recommendation on the Ethics of AI, it leverages tools like the Readiness Assessment Methodology (RAM) and Ethical Impact Assessment (EIA) to develop practical solutions for fair and sustainable AI ecosystems.
The initiative will focus on empowering civil society, expanding AI governance implementation in diverse countries, and producing analytical knowledge products to guide policy development. Key outputs include forming a global network of civil society organizations, supporting new and existing RAM processes, and creating meta-analyses and actionable frameworks for policymakers. These efforts aim to advance inclusive, responsible AI development globally, with a strong emphasis on bridging regional disparities and fostering multistakeholder collaboration.
Anticipated outcomes include deeper stakeholder engagement, improved national AI strategies, and the establishment of ethical AI as a cornerstone of governance worldwide.
The project is the phase III of the UNESCO-PJMF Collaboration on Promoting Ethical Governance of AI following succesful deliveray of the previos projects in 2023 and 2024.
